svg.title: CASTAWAY: an Atari 8-bit style demo screen
svg.desc: CASTAWAY in fat, chrome-shaded wide pixels with hue bands rolling up through the letters, over a wide-pixel island where she nods to the beat, a grey tabby naps on the palm, a coconut crab walks sideways and a bottle drifts in and out. Below: the seed-1992 ten-hour run as a scrolling row of blips, every sound synthesized from code, and python tools/serve.py -> 127.0.0.1:8765.
